subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the character shown in all views of <Picture 1>: a young East Asian woman named Chang Yan, age 21, with an elegant cool aura, long dark-brown wavy hair styled half-up with two small pinned sections at the crown, wispy see-through bangs, and long loose waves falling past her waist; mauve-pink lipstick and fair skin; a pair of silver crystal snowflake drop earrings; a silver necklace with a crystal bow pendant; wearing a white off-shoulder mini dress with a ruffled organza neckline trim, a strapless ruched bodycon bodice exposing her bare shoulders and collarbones; and white strappy platform stiletto heels.
<Subject 2> is a 1:7 scale commercial PVC collectible figure of <Subject 1>, with the smooth satin-sheen finish of a painted garage kit, standing upright with her weight slightly shifted onto her right leg, chin a touch lowered with a cool forward gaze, her left arm relaxed at her side and her right hand resting lightly against the side of her thigh, the ruffled neckline and hem falling naturally, on a round black display base engraved with a gold nameplate reading "LH-001 畅颜".
<Subject 3> is an adult human right hand with clean natural skin and short trimmed nails, entering the frame.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 2>, a 1:7 scale collectible figure of the character in <Picture 1>, standing on a hobbyist desk, then <Subject 3> gently picks it up and presents it upward, downward, left and right with a subtle phone-style handheld sway, before placing it back on the desk.

retention_analysis:

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the 1:7 figure proportions, PVC satin sheen, the standing pose with right hand resting against her thigh, and the round black base with gold nameplate are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the same right hand throughout.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a photorealistic, casual product-showcase style, looking like a smartphone video shot in a warm hobby workshop, with gentle handheld micro-shake throughout.
[Shot 1] A vertical medium shot establishes a hobbyist desk under soft warm lighting: a large monitor displaying the grayscale 3D modeling process of the white-dress figure, a BANDAI-style product box printed with the original artwork of <Subject 1>, paint bottles, brushes and a hobby knife scattered on the desk. Centered among them stands <Subject 2>, the 1:7 PVC figure of <Subject 1> on its round black base, her appearance and pose identical to the opening throughout the shot. <Subject 3> enters from the lower right, fingers cupping the base, and slowly lifts the figure about thirty centimeters while the camera performs a handheld follow, rising smoothly and keeping the figure centered.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a steady close-up of <Subject 2> held at chest height. Only the hand moves the figure; the figure itself never changes pose or expression. <Subject 3> slowly tilts the figure upward, then downward, then rotates it gently to the left and to the right within a small arc. Soft light slides across the white ruched dress, sweeping a delicate satin sheen along the ruched folds, the organza ruffle at the neckline glowing faintly translucent at the edges, and a small sparkle flaring on the crystal snowflake earrings and the bow pendant, while the camera holds the close-up with light handheld sway like a phone-shot unboxing clip, the desk softly blurred behind.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, <Subject 3> lowers the figure back toward the desk as the camera performs a handheld tilt-down following the descent. The fingers set the base precisely back on its original spot, give it a tiny adjustment, then withdraw out of the lower right of the frame, and the final seconds rest on the same desk composition as the opening, the figure unchanged from the first frame.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet workshop room tone continues throughout, with a faint plastic-and-wood touch sound as the hand grips and releases the base, a soft tap as the base settles back onto the desk, and a barely audible fabric rustle during the rotation. No speech.
